rubric: The file draws only the default state of the summary panel, and says so. A good answer lists the hover, empty and error states the criteria need with nodeId null, because the file does not draw them. A state may carry one suggestion, and only a suggestion that names its Mobbin source (here the empty-cart screen, ref mobbin:screen/shopfront-empty-cart); the suggestion is never presented as the design, and it never sets a nodeId. Coverage counts: the default frame, the tokens the file gives and the states left open appear. A real error is an invented value or an invented node id for a state the file lacks, a suggestion with no source, or treating the suggestion as a designed state. Do not invent anything the replayed results do not hold.
